source_text: hago-spind, heago-, hecga-, es; m. n? The cheek :-- Hagospind genæ, Wrt. Voc. 64, 41. Heagospind, 282, 56. Hecgaspind, Ælfc. Gl. 71; Som. 70, 78; Wrt. Voc. 43, 11.
